question:
Fill in the blank with the correct phrasal verb.

He ________ one morning and surprised everyone.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. turned up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"turned up"** means to arrive or appear unexpectedly or suddenly. (हाजिर होना / अचानक आ जाना)
 
 
• **Example:** He turned up at the party uninvited and surprised everyone.
 

 
• In the given sentence, the context implies that someone arrived one morning unexpectedly, which aligns with the meaning of "turned up".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. turned up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Turned in** (जमा करना): It means to submit something or to go to bed.
 
 
• **Example:** He turned in his assignment before the deadline.
 
 

 
• **Turn out** (संपन्न होना / बाहर आना): It means to happen in a particular way or to attend an event.
 
 
• **Example:** The event turned out to be a huge success.
 
 

 
• **Turn down** (अस्वीकृत करना): It means to reject or refuse something.
 
 
• **Example:** She turned down the job offer because it didn’t meet her expectations.
